title: PortfolioInstitutionState
description: The portfolio/institution state extensions (Step 2R WP2R.6, R6/R7). SCHEMA-LEVEL ONLY: implementation is Step 3 (WP3.7 portfolio engine, WP3.8 institutional twin). These are the variables that make a DB pension twin behave like a pension rather than an endowment with liabilities attached: rate/inflation hedge ratios, the collateral pool (eligible assets, haircuts, posted, headroom), explicit and pass-through leverage, portfolio-level fee drag, and the FX hedge ratio consistent with the sealed R5 decision (FX out of scope for the v1 campaign; the FIELD exists so the contract does not need to move when the next campaign adds the FX block per S2R-FX-NEXT-CAMPAIGN). Sleeve-level state lives in sleeve-vehicle-state-v1.0.schema.json; this document composes sleeves by id.

cash.description: The cash account (portfolio currency units). Receives distributions, income, redemption proceeds; pays calls, subscriptions, fees, benefits/spending (spec section 4.4).

sleeve_ids.description: The sleeves this portfolio holds, by taxonomy/sleeves.yaml id (alternatives) or liquid_* id (funding sleeves). Sleeve state itself is per sleeve-vehicle-state-v1.0.

fee_drag_bps_annual.description: R6: portfolio-level fee-drag aggregation, annualized basis points on total value. Computed by WP3.7; a stored stub carries 0.

transaction_cost_defaults_bps.description: R6: default one-way transaction cost per liquid sleeve id, basis points. A liquid sleeve's own transaction_cost_bps (sleeve-vehicle-state) overrides its default here.

hedging.description: R6: the hedge ratios WP3.8's twin consumes. All are fractions of the corresponding liability exposure hedged, 0..1.5 (over-hedging above 1.0 is real and allowed; far above it is a data error).

rates_hedge_ratio.description: Interest-rate hedge ratio (fraction of liability PV01 hedged).

inflation_hedge_ratio.description: Inflation hedge ratio (fraction of liability IE01 hedged).

fx_hedge_ratio.description: FX hedge ratio. Consistent with sealed R5: the v1 campaign generates no FX factor, so v1 institutions are modeled fully-hedged-or-single-currency and this field is inert at default 0; it becomes live when the next campaign's FX block lands (S2R-FX-NEXT-CAMPAIGN).

collateral_pool.description: R7: the collateral pool behind the hedges - eligible assets with haircuts, what is posted, and the headroom that determines how far rates can move before forced unwinds (the gilt-crisis mechanic).

sleeve_id.description: A liquid sleeve id eligible as collateral.

haircut.description: Fractional haircut applied to this asset's value when posted.

eligible_assets.description: The haircut schedule over eligible collateral assets.

posted.description: Collateral currently posted (portfolio currency units, post-haircut).

headroom.description: Eligible-but-unposted capacity (post-haircut). The variable the 2022 gilt episode was ABOUT.

leverage.description: R7: explicit (institution-level borrowing / repo / LDI leverage) and pass-through (looking through leveraged vehicles), both as ratios of net asset value. 1.0 = unlevered.

explicit_ratio.description: Gross exposure / NAV from explicit borrowing and derivative leverage.

pass_through_ratio.description: Look-through leverage carried inside vehicles (e.g. platform multi-strat pass-through).
